global_layer.context: A single continuous macro-style take of a pianist's hands on a grand piano.
global_layer.description: Close-up of two hands playing a flowing arpeggio on the keys, then a soft final chord.

aesthetics.color_scheme: black lacquer, ivory keys, warm skin tones

audio_baseline.ambience: a quiet concert hall with a slight natural reverb

lighting_baseline.conditions: a single warm spotlight from above
lighting_baseline.shadows: crisp shadows of the fingers on the keys
lighting_baseline.source_consistency: the lighting holds steady for the full clip

environment_baseline.background_setting: the black lacquered body of a grand piano fading into darkness

alive_subjects_static.description: the hands of an adult pianist
alive_subjects_static.position: on the keyboard, filling the lower two thirds

visual_attributes.hands: slender fingers, short clean nails, a thin silver ring on the right hand

camera_cinematography.overall_camera_style: slow lateral slide along the keyboard
camera_cinematography.default_depth_of_field: very shallow; the fingers sharp, keys falling off into blur

segment_basic_info.segment_description: The right hand plays a rising arpeggio while the left holds a low chord.

camera_delta.composition: close-up, keys diagonal across the frame

action.motion_detail: fingers press keys one after another in a smooth wave; keys visibly depress and rise

special_audio_events.sound_description: a flowing rising piano arpeggio in C major with natural hall reverb
special_audio_events.visual_sync: each note matches a key going down

segment_basic_info.segment_description: Both hands come together for a soft final chord and lift slowly from the keys.

action.primary_action: playing a final chord and lifting
action.motion_detail: all fingers press at once, hold, then rise gently off the keys

special_audio_events.sound_description: the chord rings and fades into the hall reverb
